_about: Curated CORDIS DET queries for Horizon Europe – WIDERA (Widening & ERA) call subjects, keyed by the subject the tagger looks up (Call.topic_title where present, else the call title / Call.name). Subjects auto-extracted verbatim from the grouped work-programme JSON, queries hand/AI-authored in the contenttype=project phrase-quoted style of cluster_1.json/cluster_3.json. CORDIS indexes EU RESEARCH projects (FP1-Horizon Europe); for non-research calls these find thematically related research, so a call's tags are the research fields of related funded projects, NOT its official scope. Re-run POST /cordis/tag-calls {"source":"widera"} to apply.

queries.Teaming Synergies: contenttype=project AND ("Teaming" OR "centres of excellence" OR "centre of excellence") AND ("widening" OR "low R&I performing" OR "research excellence")

queries.Research Management Facility: contenttype=project AND ("research management" OR "research managers" OR "research support") AND ("capacity building" OR "widening" OR "professional development")
queries.ERA Fellowships: contenttype=project AND ("postdoctoral fellowship" OR "postdoctoral fellowships" OR "researcher mobility") AND ("widening" OR "career development" OR "researchers")

queries.Pillar III: Fostering citizen engagement: contenttype=project AND ("citizen engagement" OR "public engagement" OR "citizen science") AND ("responsible research and innovation" OR "science and society" OR "participatory")
